title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Remove Everything Unused stopped two rounds before it was done on the project it was built for, because its limit was written without measuring.

highlights.title: The loop runs long enough to finish
highlights.description: Applied to a fixed point on a 6329 source project it takes ten rounds: the tail is a chain of constants each alive only for the next. The limit was eight. It is sixteen now, and the loop shows its round and can be stopped between two.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The round limit of Remove Everything Unused is a measured number with room above it, not a guess below the need.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: The merged path had never been applied for real. It has now, to a fixed point: 62 files deleted, 138 modified, zero brace or parenthesis left unbalanced across the 5048 remaining.
Every one of the 259 cuts the five families would produce alone is kept by the merge or contained in a cut it keeps; the 32 it drops are duplicates.
